title: Trump Teleprompter Pays $170,000 to End Insider Trading Probe
summary: A White House teleprompter operator will pay more than $172,000 to end a federal regulator’s probe into alleged well-timed prediction market bets about President Donald Trump’s speeches.

title: Indian Bank Stocks Show Widest Exchange Price Gap in Decades
summary: Shares of some Indian banks closed at sharply different prices on the country’s two largest exchanges on Thursday, the latest sign of dislocation under the new closing auction system.
